summary: Primoris Services Corp filed an 8-K on August 4, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 results (revenue down 10.7% to $1.69B; net loss of $24.2M) and a board-declared cash dividend of $0.08/share, record date September 30, payable October 15, 2026. This is a routine earnings and dividend declaration, not a special situation. The filing contains no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other transactional events. The dividend is ordinary and small relative to share price. No deal terms are applicable. Nothing to watch; event is informational only.
